title: Concept: Azure blob SAS URL in a response
description: A blob storage URL that carries a shared-access signature in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The signature authorises whoever holds it to read, write or delete the blob until it expires, and it travels in history, logs and Referer headers exactly like any other URL.
applicability: Statement downloads, document previews and receipt archives.
risk: A leaked write-capable signature lets an attacker replace a statement or delete records.
